title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java + React), Noida
description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance. We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.
  
  
Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers will work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Act as a hands-on engineer and architect supporting initiatives from small features to complex systems. Lead projects, mentor teams, and collaborate with other practices to ensure successful delivery.
* Design and build full-stack applications using Java (primary) and React (secondary), ensuring scalable architecture, efficient APIs, and seamless integration between back-end and front-end services.
* Support backend development using Java (e.g., Spring/Spring Boot) to build and maintain RESTful services, business logic, and integrations with enterprise systems and databases.
* Partner with client stakeholders to build strong relationships, acting as a strategic technical advisor and helping expand long-term engagements.
* Support business development efforts through solution design, client presentations, and contributing to proposals and industry engagement.
* Help develop strong management practices within the Engineering practice, supporting career growth and mentoring across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop responsive web applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.
* Design and integrate RESTful APIs with frontend components.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.
* Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews and CI/CD processes.

**Required Skills**

* 8+ years of software development experience.
* Backend development experience with Java / Spring Boot.
* Experience in React
* Experience with REST APIs, Git, and modern development practices.

**Preferred**

* Experience with microservices, AWS and Terraform.
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes and containerized deployments.
* Experience in capital markets, financial markets/products, consulting is highly desirable.
* Experience with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot is a plus.

Why Lab49?
  
  
Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.
  
  
Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.
  
  
Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.
  
  
*We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

title: Senior AI & Decision Science Engineer
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Full-Stack AI & Automation Engineer**
**Human Resources - Strategic Planning & Analytics CoE**
**About The Team & Your Role**
Strategic Planning & Analytics team is architected to move beyond traditional HR, functioning as a strategic engine that fuels ST’s growth through five specialized pillars: Business Partnerships, Products & AI, Workforce Insights, Data Science, and Workforce Planning Architecture. We are currently in an ambitious build-phase, moving away from legacy processes to create a sophisticated, tech-enabled function that mirrors the engineering excellence of the semiconductor industry. We don’t want to just manage headcount; we want to orchestrate the future of HR using AI.
  
  
As a member of this team, you won’t be working in a silo. You will be at the intersection of human capital and advanced technology, leveraging AI and data science to solve complex organizational challenges and expected to be a foundational builder. We are looking for pioneers to help us design and implement our first generation of advanced analytics and AI-driven products. You won't just be using technology—you will be architecting the roadmap, selecting the tools, and establishing the frameworks that will define how ST manages its global talent for years to come. If you are energized by the challenge of redefining the "H" in HR through the lens of data and innovation, you’ve found the right place.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* End-to-End AI Prototyping: Architect, build, and deploy conversational bots and transactional AI agents from scratch in a sandbox environment.
* Workflow Orchestration & Automation: Design and manage complex, multi-system automation workflows using tools like n8n to automate actions (e.g., orchestrating system lookups, mock API executions, and conditional task routing).
* LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Integrate prototypes securely with internal OpenAI/ChatGPT APIs, mastering prompt design, function calling, tool use, and state management.
* Interface & UI/UX Evolution: Build lightweight, responsive web interfaces (e.g., Streamlit, Next.js) for quick stakeholder testing, ensuring the backend logic is decoupled via webhooks for future migration into Microsoft Teams.
* Code Hygiene & Handoff Documentation: Maintain code transparency, track version changes, and collaborate efficiently using GitHub. Author structured "Industrialization Blueprints" (JSON payloads, API mappings, and logic flows) to seamlessly hand over for full scale production

**Required Background & Skills**

* AI Orchestration Frameworks: Expert-level workflow creation using tools like n8n (advanced JavaScript/Python execution nodes, webhooks, and sub-workflows) or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* AI & LLM Mastery: Practical experience implementing conversational APIs, embedding architectures, vector stores, and advanced prompt engineering constraints.
* Full-Stack Core Development: Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/Node.js. Comfort writing clean API connectors, handling RESTful requests, parsing JSON, and maintaining code via GitHub.
* Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystems: Prior familiarity or structural understanding of building integration layers, bots, or webhooks for the Microsoft 365 / MS Teams ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Candidate should possess “Can-do” attitude, with an ability to thrive in an unstructured environment
* 9 to 12 years of software engineering/automation experience (with at least 2–3 years focused on building AI agents/bots from scratch).
* Masters/ PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology equivalent
* Understanding of HCM systems like Oracle is an added advantage
* Excellent English, quantitative, technical, and storytelling skills

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: App Dev & Support Engineer II
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Job Track Description:**

* Role Overview
* This role requires strong collaboration with product managers, frontend developers and QA teams to build reliable and scalable backend systems. As a Backend Developer, you’ll be part of our core product-engineering team, designing and developing high-performance APIs and platform services that power modern digital applications. You will work closely with frontend developers and product teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient backend solutions used by some of the most respected Fortune 500 companies.
* What You’ll Do
* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using .NET Core (.NET 8/9).
* Develop and maintain REST APIs and gRPC services used by applications.
* Work with SQL Server for relational data storage and use Dapper & Entity Framework for data access.
* Write automated unit and integration tests for end-to-end testing using Playwright.
* Work with Azure DevOps for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and deployments.
* Collaborate closely with product and frontend teams to ship high-quality features.
* Required Skills
* Experience with .NET Core / .NET 8/9 and C#
* Experience developing REST APIs and Web APIs
* Experience working with gRPC services
* Experience with automated testing tools (like Playwright)
* Experience with SQL Server skills.
* Experience with Dapper and Entity Framework.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and Git-based workflows
* Understanding of API based architecture and security (JWT, OAuth2)
* Nice to Have
* Experience building cloud-native applications (Azure preferred).
* Integration experience with Keycloak, Azure Communication services (ACS)
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker / Kubernetes).
* Experience in product-driven or SaaS environments
* Experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles

title: Senior Associate Technology L1_Python
description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
“AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future-ready.
  
  
**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302349
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: SAP CPI-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting – SAP CPI PI Senior:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior with expertise in SAP CPI Implementation to join the EYD GDS Integration practice. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gathers specifications from the business and functional departments and deliver the solution that meets the needs presented
* Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Must be able to work on custom integration as well as standard integration packages
* Must have knowledge of SAP Cloud Connector and CPI cockpit

* Must be aware of SAP CPI support activities
* Must be able to perform root cause analysis of any re-occurring or critical issues and proposing solutions for them

* Experience with business process orchestration products like Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), Dell Boomi, SAP Process Integration (PI) / Process Orchestration (PO).
* Experience to deliver projects for customers, including requirement gathering, analysis of system landscape, technical design, and development of interface.
* Experience to build Integration Strategy for customers having on premise and cloud application systems (SuccessFactors, S4HANA, Ariba etc) with an expertise on data architecture, governance and pre-packaged cloud integration.
* Exposure to various business scenarios (A2A and B2B) and experience in working on all major adapters like SFTP, SOAP, REST, IDOC, ODATA, JDBC, SuccessFactors etc.
* Clarity of security concepts - SSL and PGP encryptions etc.
* Prefer to have experience in Groovy scripts.

**Responsibilities, Qualifications, Certifications**
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 3-7 years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* SAP certification is a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Should have understanding and experience of integration best practices
* Excellent business communication skills
* Excellent leadership skills

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Integration practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**Role: Director of Engineering**

**Location: Bengaluru and Noida**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Company:**

At PhysicsWallah (PW), we are on a mission to democratize education at scale in India. What started as a vision by our founder Alakh Pandey to provide high-quality, affordable education to every student has now grown into India's leading EdTech unicorn. * **Strategic Execution:**
  Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Business teams to align engineering deliverables with the company’s product roadmap and business goals.
* **Operational Excellence:**
  Establish and enforce best practices in software development, CI/CD, automation, code reviews, testing, and system monitoring.
* **Innovation & AI Integration:**
  Spearhead the adoption of modern technologies, including AI/ML frameworks, to personalize student learning and optimize internal operations.
* **Resource Management:**
  Manage budgets, infrastructure costs, and engineering bandwidth effectively, honoring our core value of operational frugality without compromising on quality.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in a senior engineering leadership role (Director, Associate Director or Senior Engineering Manager).
* **Full-Stack Technical Expertise:**
  Strong experience across frontend and backend engineering, with expertise in technologies such as Node.js, NestJS, Golang, React.js, and Next.js.
* **Backend & Distributed Systems:**
  Deep understanding of system design, distributed systems, microservices, API design, and event-driven architectures.
* **Frontend Architecture:**
  Experience designing and scaling modern frontend applications, with strong understanding of performance optimization, frontend architecture, and user experience.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
* **Database Mastery:**
  Extensive knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL), caching mechanisms (Redis), and data sharding at scale.
* **B2C Scale Experience:**
  Proven track record of building and scaling high-traffic consumer tech products with massive Daily Active Users (DAU) and Monthly Active Users (MAU).
* **Agile Methodology:**
  Strong command over agile software development practices and a history of leading successful sprints and timely product launches.

**What You Will Need**

* **A Student-First Mindset:**
  A deep, genuine passion for education and an empathetic understanding of the challenges faced by students across the country.
* **Problem-Solving DNA:**
  The ability to break down complex, ambiguous technical problems into actionable, elegant solutions.
* **Exceptional Communication:**
  The clarity to translate highly technical concepts into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, and the ability to articulate business goals to engineering teams.
* **Resilience & Agility:**
  The energy to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can shift to meet market demands.
* **Frugal Innovation:**
  The mindset to build smart, cost-effective technology solutions that allow us to keep our courses highly affordable for the masses.

title: Team Lead C++, Software Development
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
  
  
We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day-to-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers.
  
  
We are looking for a team lead with experience working across servers and clients with knowledge of Ruby On Rails, C++, JavaScript and more. You will lead the work to bring capabilities from our Observability platform into our DEX platform. This will involve making technical decisions about the best way we can integrate to provide our users with the best customer experience whilst ensuring that we can converge our 2 platforms into a single unified, scalable, maintainable platform.
  
  
Our observability platform consists of an agent (C++, QT, Electron, JavaScript), a UI (React, Vue, Angular) and a backend (Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS EC2). Our DEX platform consists of an agent (C++), a UI (React) and a backend (C# .Net Core 8 running on Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EventHub, Kafka, Databricks).
  
  
You will own the delivery of the roadmap, working closely with our existing observability team that is US-based to deliver the integration whilst also supporting the maintenance of the existing platform.
  
  

* Own delivery roadmap and technical direction for integrating the acquired product into our platform and delivery of new features.
* Drive architectural decisions that meet product requirements whilst considering key non-functional requirements such as scalability, security and maintainability – taking an approach that aligns with our north star of converging to a single unified platform.
* Align stakeholders (Product, Security, Operations) and manage risks, dependencies and scope.
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards: CI/CD quality gates, secure SDLC, and observability/SLOs.
* Coach and develop the team; enable predictable delivery and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**

* A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject
* 12+ years of software development experience with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team.
* Experienced in leading delivery of cloud-based solution that has required collaboration across different teams.
* Experience with Azure/AWS cloud services such as: Kafka, Kubernetes, Redis, event streaming
* Experience leading project delivery in collaboration with remote teams
* Experience working with C++, JavaScript and QT
* Experience applying engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations.
* Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top-10 vulnerabilities & remediation, and Threat Modeling
* Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
* Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
* A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.
* A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
* Fluency in English is mandatory.
* Experience working with network protocols such as TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, SSL/TLS, UDP, SIP, RTP is a plus.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This role sits at the intersection of enterprise UX and platform engineering. The screens you build are not cosmetic — they are where human reviewers approve payments, resolve invoice exceptions, configure ERP connectors, and track STP performance across clients. You will work in React or Angular on the frontend, Node.js or Python for backend APIs, and DynamoDB for data storage — all hosted on AWS. You will collaborate closely with AI engineers, backend platform engineers, and finance domain SMEs to deliver a product that is both technically solid and genuinely usable by finance operations teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities- Build and maintain the Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) worklist UI — enabling finance reviewers to view queued tasks, inspect AI recommendations with supporting context, take approval or rejection decisions, add notes, and trigger escalations.
  
  

* Develop the exception management dashboard — displaying real-time exception queues by type, aging bucket, and priority, with drill-down into individual exception detail, resolution history, and lifecycle status.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs in Node.js or Python that serve the frontend, connecting UI interactions to the underlying platform services — orchestration, exception routing, approval workflows, audit trail, and notifications.
* Design DynamoDB table schemas and access patterns for workflow state, tenant configuration, exception lifecycle records, and audit events — applying single-table design and GSI strategies for efficient querying.
* Implement real-time UI updates using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events (SSE) to keep worklists, exception queues, and workflow status indicators live without full-page refreshes.
* Integrate with AWS Cognito or equivalent for authentication and role-based access control — ensuring that tenant isolation, approver role restrictions, and audit trail requirements are enforced at the API layer.
* Collaborate with AI and backend engineers to surface LLM-generated recommendations, confidence scores, and agent reasoning in the UI in a way that helps human reviewers make faster, better-informed decisions.
* Ensure frontend observability — client-side error tracking, performance monitoring, and usage analytics — to support continuous improvement of the user experience across clients.

Required Skills- 5+ years of fullstack engineering experience with strong proficiency in React or Angular and Node.js or Python.
  
  

* Strong TypeScript skills across both frontend and backend.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services — Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, Cognito, SQS, and SNS.
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs — including API design, versioning, error handling, and pagination.
* Proficiency with state management libraries — Redux or Redux Toolkit (React), NgRx (Angular), or equivalent.
* Experience building form-heavy, data-intensive enterprise UIs — multi-step forms, configurable tables, inline editing, and complex validation.
* Understanding of authentication and authorisation patterns — OAuth 2.0, JWT, session management, and role-based access control.
* Strong grasp of web performance fundamentals — lazy loading, code splitting, caching strategies, and optimistic UI updates.
* Experience building approval workflow or task management UIs where human decisions are a core interaction pattern — not just CRUD screens.

Preferred Qualifications- Solid experience with DynamoDB — data modelling, single-table design, Global Secondary Indexes (GSIs), and query optimisation for high-throughput read/write patterns.
  
  

* Experience with data visualisation libraries (Recharts, Chart.js, D3, Highcharts, or Angular equivalents) for building operational dashboards with filtering and drill-down.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerised deployments (Docker, AWS ECS or Lambda).
* Prior experience building UIs for Finance and Accounting operations — invoice processing, payments, reconciliation, or similar workflows.
* Exposure to drag-and-drop or visual mapping interfaces — field mappers, flow builders, or rule configurators — relevant to the integration layer configuration UI.
* Familiarity with audit trail and compliance requirements in regulated environments — understanding how user actions in the UI must be logged and traceable.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with LLM or AI services — surfacing model outputs, confidence indicators, and explanations in a user-friendly way.
* Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) for enterprise application UIs.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architecture for large-scale platform applications.
* Experience with AWS Amplify or similar frameworks for accelerating frontend-to-AWS service connectivity.

Understanding of Finance and Accounting KPIs — STP rate, first-pass match rate, exception aging — and how operational teams use these metrics to manage performance

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent the last few years building AI systems that actually ship, not just prototypes that look good in a slide deck. You know the difference between a demo that impresses in a meeting and a production system that runs reliably at 3 AM when no one is watching. You understand that the hard part is not getting an LLM to respond, it is building the orchestration, memory, retrieval, and guardrails that make it work consistently across real workflows.
  
  
You are comfortable moving between agent frameworks, backend services, and user-facing components without losing sight of what you are actually solving. When a multi-step workflow fails, you do not just retry it, you trace the state, check the memory, review the tool calls, and figure out what broke three steps earlier. You think in systems, not scripts.
  
  
You care about the details that make AI applications reliable: evaluation frameworks that catch hallucinations, observability that surfaces why an agent chose a particular path, memory architectures that actually remember what matters. You do not wait for perfect requirements. You ask the right questions, build something that works, and iterate based on what you learn.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work on agentic AI systems that directly impact how engineering teams design chips and build the technology that powers everything from autonomous vehicles to machine learning hardware.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Design, build, test, and deploy agentic AI applications using ADK, NAT, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenCode to create workflow-driven systems that handle planning, reasoning, task decomposition, and multi-step orchestration
* Implement and optimize agent memory systems including semantic, procedural, episodic, working, session, and long-term memory with consolidation and retrieval strategies that make agents actually remember context across conversations
* Build RAG pipelines that combine embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and contextual grounding to ground agent responses in real enterprise knowledge bases and documentation
* Integrate agents with enterprise APIs, tools, databases, and search systems using function calling, tool calling, MCP, and connector patterns that make external services accessible to LLM-driven workflows
* Develop backend services, orchestration layers, REST APIs, and user-facing components including human-in-the-loop experiences and operational dashboards that give users visibility and control
* Build automated evaluation frameworks that measure answer quality, memory relevance, tool-use success, trajectory quality, hallucination rates, latency, cost, and safety across production workloads
* Implement observability through tracing, structured logging, prompt versioning, model tracking, workflow telemetry, and incident analysis so you can diagnose failures and improve system behavior over time

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Accelerate how Synopsys IP design teams work by delivering agentic AI systems that automate complex EDA workflows and reduce time spent on repetitive engineering tasks
* Build reliable AI applications that combine LLMs, tools, memory, and retrieval into production systems that engineering teams trust and depend on daily
* Establish reusable patterns, components, and engineering practices that make it faster for other teams to build and ship their own AI-enabled applications
* Improve the quality and safety of AI systems across Synopsys by implementing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability that catch issues before they reach users
* Contribute to the technical maturity of the AI engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, mentorship, and knowledge sharing that raises the bar for everyone
* Help position Synopsys as a leader in responsible, enterprise-grade AI by building systems that balance capability with security, reliability, and ethical deployment

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or equivalent practical experience
* 2+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with demonstrated experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI applications
* Strong proficiency in Python and working knowledge of at least one of JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C++, or Go
* Hands-on experience with one or more agentic frameworks such as ADK, NAT, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies
* Strong understanding of LLM application design, workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, tool and function calling, RAG and Hybrid Graph/RAG architectures, agent memory systems, and single-agent and multi-agent patterns
* Experience with vector databases, embeddings, search systems, reranking, and knowledge-retrieval pipelines that power RAG and semantic search
* Experience building full-stack AI applications including backend APIs or microservices and user-facing AI experiences, plus experience testing and evaluating non-deterministic AI systems, familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Git-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, and Agile practices, and understanding of AI observability, security, privacy, guardrails, and responsible AI principles are all strong pluses

Who You Are
  
  

* You can take a vague product requirement and turn it into a working agentic workflow without needing someone to spell out every implementation detail
* You move fluidly between designing an agent's reasoning loop, debugging a memory retrieval issue, writing backend API code, and explaining a tradeoff to a product manager
* You write code that other engineers can read, maintain, and extend, and you care enough about engineering quality to push back when a shortcut will create problems three months from now
* You can explain why an agent chose a particular tool or how a memory system decides what to retain in a way that makes sense to both a senior architect and a designer building a user interface
* You are the kind of engineer who digs into production logs at 11 PM not because you have to, but because you want to understand why a workflow failed and how to prevent it next time
* You treat AI systems with the same rigor you would apply to any production software: you think about failure modes, edge cases, observability, security, and the humans who will depend on what you build

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of Synopsys' effort to leverage Generative and Agentic AI to enhance the productivity of IP Design teams. The team is building agents and orchestration platforms that target EDA chip design flows, working at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technology and the complex engineering workflows that power semiconductor development. You will collaborate with other engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, platform teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions that solve high-value problems for engineering teams across the company.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 Good to have

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Integrations & Partner Enablement
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (all genders) to join our new Integrations \& Partner Enablement team in Noida. The team connects TeamViewer products to the enterprise systems our customers run on, such as ERP, warehouse management (WMS) and manufacturing execution (MES) systems, and gives partners the tools to build integrations on their own.
   

  

 You will own integration features end to end, shape technical direction for our SDKs and integration templates, and act as a technical reference and mentor in the team. The work is mostly backend, with web frontend work on our extension tools. You will work closely with engineering and product teams in Europe.
   

  

* Design, build and maintain our Connector SDK, integration templates and backend services using Java/Kotlin with Spring Boot or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Build web extensions and tooling with React and TypeScript.
* Drive design decisions for scalable, secure and reusable integrations, applying event\-driven and API\-first principles.
* Design data mapping and transformation between our products and enterprise systems such as SAP, WMS and MES.
* Turn customer\-specific integrations into standard, configurable templates.
* Write developer documentation, samples and guides for partners and system integrators, and support them technically.
* Drive testing strategy across the stack (unit, integration, contract, end\-to\-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development in the team: set good practices, share workflows and keep quality high.
* Mentor other engineers, lead code reviews and promote engineering best practices.


**Requirements**
* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6\+ years of professional experience in software development across backend and frontend, with a track record of leading technical topics.
* Strong backend experience with Java and/or Kotlin and Spring Boot, or with Node.js and TypeScript.
* Solid experience with React and TypeScript.
* Strong experience with enterprise integration: REST APIs, data mapping and transformation, event\-driven integration and messaging.
* Good understanding of authentication and authorization standards such as OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Docker and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS).
* Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and a clear view on how to use them responsibly in a team.
* A consulting mindset: able to understand a customer process and turn it into a reusable, standard solution.
* Experience mentoring engineers and working in agile teams.
* Good working\-hours overlap with Central European Time.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).


**Nice to have**
* Background in SAP consulting or a systems integrator, or at a product company with an integration platform or SDK (e.g. iPaaS, WMS or MES vendors).
* Experience with SAP integrations (e.g. SAP EWM, SAP S/4HANA, OData, BAPI/RFC, IDoc, SAP BTP / Integration Suite); SAP certification is a plus.
* Experience with WMS or MES products (e.g. Manhattan, Blue Yonder, Körber, Siemens Opcenter) and understanding of logistics, warehouse or manufacturing processes.
* Experience building SDKs, developer tools or developer documentation.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to Europe.


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
   

  

 If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

title: Java Full Stack Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Java Full Stack Technical Lead, you will be expected to work as a self\-driven individual contributor with strong ownership of end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of product features across both backend and frontend layers. You should be hands\-on in Java\-based backend services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud\-native deployments, and modern frontend development using frameworks such as React or Angular. Along with independent technical contribution, the role requires mentoring junior engineers in the team, guiding implementation decisions, reviewing code, ensuring secure and high\-quality delivery, supporting customer escalations, and driving innovation through PoCs and continuous improvements.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Java Full Stack Technical Lead will be responsible for independently leading product feature development across backend and frontend layers, including design, implementation, validation, and delivery of scalable software applications and systems.
* The candidate should be hands\-on and technically strong enough to contribute as an individual contributor while also providing technical leadership, design direction, code reviews, and guidance to the team.
* Mandatory experience is required in both backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, and cloud\-native patterns, as well as frontend engineering using React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, UI integration, and responsive web application development.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be a constraint for the right person; however, strong hands\-on exposure to Java full stack development is mandatory. The role involves Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, and ownership of deployments and chart definitions for our applications.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 7\+ years of application development experience, including strong hands\-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing and implementing REST API based backend applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot frameworks.
* Strong exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is mandatory, with the ability to collaborate on UI architecture, review frontend implementation, and ensure seamless integration with backend services.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 The Senior Power Platform Engineer 2 role works within our agile/scrum Product Engineering team to contribute to major engineering initiatives. This role is leading initiatives they often establish with limited guidance to the definition of done, working with immediate peers, and communicating on a team\-wide level.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Applying current and learning new technical skills and understanding required to complete often technically more difficult tasks to the definition of done.
* Conducts and facilitates code reviews at times ensuring coding standards are being met.
* Writes technical documentation for application development.
* Maintains in\-depth knowledge of all the applications and code worked on, even code not written by the individual.
* Conducts Proof\-of\-Concepts for new solutions and/or technologies when asked and provides pro/con inputs to the team for decision making.
* Identifies, owns, and ensures implementation of work process improvement concepts.


**Qualifications/Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS, Information Systems or engineering fields, MCA, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent oral and written communications skills.
* 5 – 8\+ years of relevant experience.
* Understanding of object\-orient programming (OOP) and Design Patterns.
* 3\+ years of experience with C\#, HTML, CSS, JS / jQuery.
* Experience with model\-driven Power Apps customizations with advanced configurations.
* Experience with Power Platform development via Plugins / Workflows / Actions concepts.
* Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services and / or Power BI reporting concepts.
* Experience with Dynamics 365 / Dataverse Product Modules (Sales/Marketing/Service/Field Service).
* Understanding of Power Apps Solution Management concepts.
* Understanding of Power Apps Security Management Concepts (security, roles, privilege, teams, access team, field level security).
* Experience with data migration (SSIS packages using Kingsway, Power Platform Data Import Wizard, Microsoft Fabric, or custom console app).
* Excellent Debugging Skills.
* Experience working with Power Automate (MS Flow).
* Experience working with MS Portal / Power Portal / Power Pages.
* Experience with using Azure services such as Service Bus, Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, API Manager, and Azure App Services.
* 3\+ years of experience working and delivering in Agile.
* Experience leveraging Azure DevOps (ADO) or Jira for work item management, as well as Git for version control.
* Experience with a JavaScript framework such as React, Angular, Vue, or similar, a plus.
* Experience with CI/CD automation for automated solution deployment, a plus.
* VS Unit testing, a plus.
* Technology certifications, a plus.


**Skills:**
* Communication \- Communicates with organization. Helps others in the team to communicate.
* Empathy \& Humility \- Constantly pushes for a better understanding of the needs and perspectives of those outside your viewpoint. Makes sound design/coding decisions keeping customer in the forefront.
* Initiative – Uses your own judgment to make decisions without asking another person's advice.
* Objectivity \& Adaptability \- Takes problems outside your skillset and quickly adapts to solve them. Helps peers do the same.
* Growth Mindset – Actively looks for opportunities to try and learn new things. Hungry to try new tools and techniques or try new areas of the business to test yourself.
* Writing Code – Consistently writes production\-ready code across complex products. You are regularly trusted to lead complex and business\-critical coding including guiding others.
* Testing – Independently tests and advises the rest of the team on quality of tests.
* Debugging \& Monitoring – Uses systematic debugging to diagnose all issues located to a single service and drives monitoring work across the team.
* Technical Understanding \& Prioritization – Is a technical and prioritization leader within the team, including taking some ownership of other team members' technical growth and development.
* Security – Consistently approaches all engineering work with a security lens.
* Software Architecture – Has a good understanding of, and designs functions that are aligned with, the overall service architecture. You understand changes may have effect beyond the immediate change. Also understands changes may impact external integrations and / or other dependencies and is conscious to plan and communicate accordingly.
* Business Context – Understands how the business works and the goals of the team. Can relate that to their own work.
* Product Knowledge – Has a detailed understanding of areas of the product.
* Culture \& Togetherness – Is conscious of signaling and tries to act as you expect other team members to act. Works to develop good positive relationships. Participates in team activities.
* Developing Others – Recognizes strengths of peers and looks for ways to support those strengths through project work. Invests time in materials or processes to support team growth. Peers see you as an informal coach.
* Hiring \& Org Design – A competent interviewer. Follows a structured hiring process and contributes to a decision.
* Stakeholder Management – Known for being efficient and reliable, and doing what you say you will do. Proactively manages expectations even when it results in frustration or personal reputation risk.
* Team Leadership – Capable of informally managing interns and other staff. Possibly manages one or two junior team members. Does not look for glory and does not complain about work that needs to be done. Assumes good decisions in others' work. Broadly, you do what you say you are going to do.


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

* Database operations experience across relational/NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL/SQL Server, Cosmos DB/DynamoDB/MongoDB, and Redis.

* Git proficiency, Agile/Scrum experience, excellent communication, and cross\-functional/cross\-time\-zone collaboration.
* Fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic development/ops tooling to accelerate delivery and operations.

title: SAP ABAP Consultant
description:
Job Title: Senior SAP ABAP Consultant
 



 Location: Noida Corporate Office (Onsite)
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior SAP ABAP Consultant with strong experience across Classic ABAP and Modern ABAP technologies used in S/4HANA.
 



 The consultant will serve as the technical developer for custom objects, enhancements, CDS views, and integration APIs while ensuring all developments follow S/4HANA clean‑core principles, performance standards, and validation compliance.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. S/4HANA Development (Modern ABAP)
 



 · Develop CDS Views (Basic, Composite, Analytical), annotations, and custom queries.
 



 · Build OData Services using SEGW, RAP Model (Restful ABAP Programming).
 



 · Implement ABAP Restful programming for Fiori apps and S/4HANA extensions.
 



 · Work with BOPF, AMDP, ABAP on HANA, and code pushdown techniques.
 



 · Use Eclipse\-based ABAP Development Tools (ADT) for modern development.
 



  





 2\. Classic ABAP Development
 



 · Classic ABAP expertise including
 



 · Reports (Classical/Interactive/ALV),
 



 · Interfaces (IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs),
 



 · Enhancements (User Exits, Customer Exits, BAdIs),
 



 · SmartForms, Adobe Forms, Scripts,
 



 · Conversions (BDC, LSMW),
 



 · Dialog programming.
 



 · Debug and optimize existing ECC custom objects for S/4 compliance.
 



  





 3\. S/4HANA Migration \& Remediation
 



 · Analyze ECC custom code using SAP ATC, Quick Fix, and SAP Readiness Check.
 



 · Adapt custom developments to the Clean Core architecture.
 



 · Support Data Migration with ABAP\-based extract/transform/load tools.
 



 · Support conversion of output forms to Adobe Forms.
 



  





 4\. Integration \& API Development
 



 · Build APIs (OData, REST, SOAP) for integration with CPI, PO, and third\-party systems.
 



 · Support EDI/IDoc enhancements and error handling frameworks.
 



 · Collaborate with functional teams (SD, MM, PP, QM, FI/CO, EWM) to develop robust end\-to\-end solutions.
 



 5\. Performance Optimization \& Quality Assurance
 



 · Conduct HANA\-optimized performance tuning (SQLM, ST05, SAT, SCI).
 



 · Implement Exception/Logging frameworks, reusable components.
 



 · Ensure compliance with GxP/CSV, documentation, and audit trails where applicable.
 



 · Prepare technical specifications, UT scripts, and deployment documentation.
 



  





 Must\-Have Skills
 



 · 5–10 years hands\-on SAP ABAP Techno\-Functional experience.
 



 · Strong in Classic ABAP: Reports, Interfaces, Enhancements, Forms, BDC.
 



 · Strong in Modern ABAP (S/4HANA):
 



 o CDS Views
 



 o OData Services
 



 o RAP Model
 



 o AMDP / ADBC
 



 o ABAP on HANA
 



 · Proficient in Object\-Oriented ABAP.
 



 · Experience in S/4HANA migration or at least one S/4HANA implementation.
 



 · Experience in performance tuning for HANA.
 



 · Good understanding of functional modules (SD/MM/FI/PP/QM).
 



 · Hands\-on experience with Eclipse ADT.
 



 · Exposure to Clean Core and Extensibility Framework in S/4HANA.
 



 · Excellent debugging and problem\-solving abilities.
 



  





 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 



  





 · Experience with Fiori/UI5 (BAS/WebIDE) is an added advantage.
 



 · Familiarity with SolMan/ChaRM, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
 



 · Knowledge of SAP BTP, CAP, Workflow, and Event Mesh.
 


* · SAP ABAP Certification.

title: Co-Founder, Engineering & AI
description:
**Mongooz** 
 is looking for a
 **Technical Co\-Founder \& CTO** 
 to build Mongooz from the ground up.
 



 This is a deeply hands\-on role. You will code, architect, ship, debug and continuously improve the product yourself \- not just manage engineers.
 



  





 You should be able to take a product idea, break it into the right technical approach, and turn it into a reliable production feature. As we grow, you’ll build and lead the engineering team. For now, we need a builder first, manager later.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





 • Building Mongooz from the ground up
 



 • Writing production code across the core platform
 



 • Designing product and system architecture
 



 • Candidate search, filters, ranking and matching
 



 • Retrieval and recommendation systems
 



 • Large\-scale structured and unstructured talent data
 



 • Backend systems, APIs and data pipelines
 



 • AI/LLM workflows, RAG and agentic systems
 



 • Product performance, reliability and scalability
 



 • Engineering standards and technical decision\-making
 



 • Hiring and developing the engineering team over time
 



  





**What we are looking for:** 




 • 6–12 years of strong software engineering experience
 



 • Deep backend and systems engineering fundamentals
 



 • Strong hands\-on coding ability
 



 • Experience building products from scratch
 



 • Experience with search, data\-intensive or recommendation products
 



 • Strong understanding of databases, indexing, query systems and APIs
 



 • Experience with Python, Postgres, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch or similar technologies
 



 • Practical experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings and modern AI systems
 



 • Experience working in a 0→1 or early\-stage startup environment
 



 • The ability to move quickly without creating fragile engineering foundations
 




 •
 
 Previous experience as a founder, founding engineer or early technical employee would be highly relevant.
 



  





**What you’re joining** 




 • Meaningful equity and genuine co\-founder ownership
 



 • A product that is GTM\-ready, with the focus now shifting toward execution, customer adoption and scale
 



 • Access to and collaboration with global data providers, giving us the foundation to build serious search and intelligence capabilities
 



 • A smart engineering team already onboard, so you are not starting with an empty room
 



 • Co\-founders with deep recruiting domain expertise and product management experience, bringing strong understanding of the problem, customer and workflow we are solving for
 




 •
 
 You will not be joining to validate whether the problem exists. You will be joining to help turn a clear problem, early product and GTM readiness into a strong, scalable technology company.

* Integrate AI outputs into dashboards, alerts, and engineering workflows without impacting plant safety or control integrity.
* Test, validate, and monitor AI solutions in live or near\-real plant environments, ensuring reliability and low false\-alarm rates.
* Continuously improve AI performance using operational feedback, historical fault data, and domain knowledge.
* Troubleshoot deployed analytics/AI tools and coordinate improvements with software or data teams.

* Hands\-on experience with DCS platforms, preferably Emerson Ovation, including control logic, alarm management, plant monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of power plant systems such as boilers, turbines, generators, combustion controls, and balance\-of\-plant operations.
* Experience developing AI\-powered applications using Python, including data processing, API integration, and workflow automation.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across operations, engineering, and software development teams.

* Experience with Emerson Ovation DCS or other power plant control systems (ABB, Honeywell, Siemens, GE, Yokogawa).
* Hands\-on experience developing AI Agents, operator assistants, troubleshooting tools, or knowledge management solutions for industrial applications.
* Knowledge of machine learning, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and time\-series analytics.
* Familiarity with vector databases, cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and industrial data integration.
* Passion for applying AI and automation technologies to improve power plant operations, reliability, and performance.

**WHY EMERSON**

 Context\-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain\-specific Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.

 Solutions with a strong background in technical program management, digital

 technology.
 



 The role will support the Digital Experience function in managing multiple
 



 workstreams across the corporate website and digital experience ecosystem,

 modernization initiatives, AI\-enabled capabilities, and security and technology
 



 dependencies.

 technical solutions, coordinate execution across multiple internal and external
 



 teams, manage operational priorities and dependencies, and ensure initiatives
 



 progress from requirement definition through implementation and stabilization.
 



 The role requires an individual with prior hands\-on technology experience who has
 



 progressed into program ownership, technical solutioning, operational
 



 management, and cross\-functional coordination. The candidate should also
 



 demonstrate strategic thinking and the ability to identify opportunities to improve
 



 platform scalability, operational efficiency, digital experience, and business impact.

 technical depth to review architecture and implementation approaches, guide
 



 development teams and partners, troubleshoot complex issues, and evaluate
 



 emerging technologies, including AI/GenAI.

 • Manage multiple digital platform programs and operational workstreams

 integrations, platform improvements, modernization, and technology initiatives.

 understanding and current\-state technical assessment through solutioning,
 



 planning, implementation, testing, release, and post\-launch stabilization.

 scalable, secure, maintainable, and technically feasible solutions across
 



 enterprise websites, digital platforms, CMS capabilities, integrations, and AIenabled
 



 solutions.

 implementation estimates, risks, dependencies, and delivery plans proposed by
 



 internal development teams and external technology partners.

 enhancements, releases, platform changes, dependencies, and business

 platform dependencies, modernization requirements, and emerging
 



 capabilities.

 modernization initiatives without operating as a full\-time/core developer.

 frontend, backend, architecture, infrastructure, security, and integration teams
 



 to ensure effective implementation and alignment with enterprise standards.

 and emerging technologies across digital experiences, search, personalization,
 



 content operations, platform workflows, and enterprise business processes.

 agents, prototypes, and AI\-enabled workflows aligned with defined business
 



 and digital requirements.
 



 • Evaluate AI and emerging technology solutions for technical feasibility,
 



 business relevance, accuracy, reliability, security, scalability, governance,
 



 maintainability, and operational readiness.
 



 • Guide development teams and external technology partners, challenge
 



 technical recommendations as needed, and ensure proposed solutions align
 



 with the agreed architecture, enterprise standards, business requirements, and
 



 platform strategy.
 



 • Coordinate with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Analytics, SEO,
 



 development teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and other partners to
 



 manage and resolve technical, operational, and delivery dependencies.
 



 • Support troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and resolution of complex
 



 application, CMS, platform, performance, integration, and operational issues.
 



 • Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation that covers
 



 solution approaches, architectural decisions, workflows, dependencies, risks,
 



 implementation requirements, operational procedures, and key platform
 



 knowledge.
 



 • Clearly communicate program status, technical solutions, architectural
 



 recommendations, AI concepts, implementation approaches, risks,
 



 dependencies, and strategic opportunities to business stakeholders, senior
 



 management, and leadership.
 



 Technical Expertise and Experience
 



 • Strong experience working with Drupal\-based enterprise platforms, including
 



 Drupal architecture, development oversight, configuration management,
 



 content architecture, modules, integrations, upgrades, APIs, and dependency
 



 management.
 



 • Experience working with enterprise CMS platforms and large\-scale digital
 



 websites with complex business, technology, integration, and operational
 



 requirements.
 



 • Strong understanding of traditional, decoupled, and headless CMS
 



 architectures, API\-driven content delivery models, and modern digital platform
 



 architecture.
 



 • Good understanding of modern web technologies and architectures, including
 



 React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, REST APIs, and related frontend/backend
 



 integration patterns.
